messages:
Noelle: Hey team  thinking of a low-effort outdoor plan: Sunset picnic + board-game swap at Mission Creek Park next weekend. Two time options: Sat 5pm (sunset) or Sun 1pm (afternoon). Also bring one board game youre willing to swap/teach. Thoughts? :sunset: :game_die:
Tariq: Love this. Saturday sunset for me. I can bring a blanket and a portable speaker.
Ben: Sunday afternoon please I've got a toddler bedtime schedule on Saturday. Also happy to bring snacks.
Aria: Sat works better for me. I can bring drinks (non-alc + sparkling).
Jules: Either works. Quick Q: is the park kid-friendly? My niece might join.
Noelle: Park has a small playground and picnic tables. Kid-friendly is fine. I'll add a note on the RSVP.
CarpoolBot: Carpool slots available: 2 seats from SoMa (6:30pm departure for Sat), 3 seats from BART (12:15pm for Sun). Reply with "carpool: your-name, seats-needed" to reserve.
Tariq: Carpool: Tariq, 1 seat (Sat).
Ben: Carpool: Ben, 1 seat (Sun).
Aria: I can drive 3 from Mission (Sat). Adding Aria: driver, 3 seats.
Noelle: Making a tiny poll for time (48h). Will also add a short RSVP form for food/dietary notes.
EventBot: Poll created: "Saturday 5pm (sunset) vs Sunday 1pm (afternoon)" Poll open for 48h.
Jules: Voting Sun 1pm because of the niece.
Tariq: Vote Sat 5pm.
Aria: Vote Sat 5pm.
Ben: Vote Sun 1pm.
EventBot: Poll results (48h): Sat 5pm 7 votes, Sun 1pm 5 votes. Outcome: Sunset picnic confirmed (Sat 5pm). Please fill RSVP: https://forms.example/picnic-swap (names, dietary notes, plus-one, carpool).
Noelle: Reservation: we'll aim for the south picnic grove near the big oak. I'll pin a map in the RSVP.
Aria: I'll bring iced tea and sparkling water. Any allergies?
Ben: I can bring chips & salsa. Note: nut allergy (please avoid).
Jules: I'll bring a kid-friendly snack box for my niece (GF options).
Tariq: Game I'm bringing: Lanterns (easy teach). Also I'll bring a small collapsible table.
Noelle: I'll bring a folding table and a picnic blanket. Game swap note: label games with your name & swap interest.
CarpoolBot: Updated carpool list: SoMa driver Aria (3 seats): reserved by Tariq (1) + 2 open. BART pickup (Sun option kept as backup).
Noelle: If anyone wants to volunteer to coordinate a tiny playlist, shout out.
Tariq: I'll grab a chill playlist and share the link.
Aria: Also bringing a first-aid kit and some extra water bottles.
EventBot: Reminder scheduled: Friday 4pm (RSVP check).
Ben: RSVP submitted (Ben). Noted nut allergy.
Jules: RSVP submitted (Jules + niece).
Noelle: Thanks everyone  final note: bring reusable utensils/plates if you have them. Closing thread  will DM final meeting spot and call tree day-of. :sparkles:
